description: Codex adapter for the repository's shared agent hooks.

hooks.command: d=$(jj workspace root 2>/dev/null || pwd); while [ ! -f "$d/hooks/run.py" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/hooks/run.py" ] && exec /usr/bin/python3 "$d/hooks/run.py" || exit 0
